scope: Ten stated per-device lifecycle contexts; units split observable unknown predicates, never one unit per numeric input or case ID. Five device contexts remain independently required.

BOUNDARY: Named controls' endpoint/adjacent/out-of-range admission and clamp/reject/rounding behavior
Voice and release-tail budget at the declared excess-note boundary
Extreme-value processing behavior; accepted domain/output enumeration remains unresolved
AUTOMATION: Named control/mode automation eligibility and admitted delivery
Automation interpolation between displayed control values
Automation smoothing compared with admitted manual edits
Modulation-versus-automation precedence with productive independent sources
Automation stop and re-enable transition behavior
TRANSPORT: Stop/seek/restart reset, free-run and retrigger behavior in admitted synced/held-note context
Repeated-note ownership across transport transitions and final NoteOff
PERSISTENCE: Device settings/routes/media preserved by Set/preset save, close, reopen and reload
Relocated or missing-media resolution and recovery behavior where media applies
Saved-state migration/version behavior; accepted historical domain unresolved
UNDO: Visible mode/route/envelope state at each Undo and Redo transition
Grouping of admitted mode, modulation and envelope edits into history operations
Held-note and sound-state rewind with Undo/Redo
Redo invalidation behavior after history changes
MALFORMED: Failure messages for admitted malformed text/media/saved control inputs
Current-state preservation or change after malformed load/import
Crash resistance/error recovery for the stated bounded malformed contexts
CANCEL: Availability of cancellation at the admitted preview/dialog entrypoint
Rollback/current-state behavior after cancellation before commitment
Preview side effects and held-note behavior during cancellation
TEARDOWN: Active-note cleanup when removing device or closing Set
Output/release-tail cutoff or survival at teardown
Resource-release behavior at device removal/Set close
SAMPLE-RATE: Rate-change admission/support while stopped and while a note is held
Timing/phase continuity across admitted rate changes
Filter-state continuity across admitted rate changes
Envelope-state continuity across admitted rate changes
Behavior across stated host-block contexts; numerical invariance/tolerances unresolved
TUNING-MPE: Participation in admitted non-12-tone tuning and global-scale contexts
Per-device per-note/global bend encoding and range behavior
Unsupported expression/tuning source handling and disconnection
Independent per-note bend, pressure and Slide isolation with two productive held notes

limits: Predicates are required unknowns, not adopted expected outcomes. Case setups provide concrete contexts but case rows and numeric examples are not the outcome denominator. UI-only histories require no audio/hardware; signal negatives require independent EACH/BOTH productive nonempty admission first. Where an old case only configures Gate, current R3 requires the distinct Trigger-positive Hold context.
